            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h1 id="拼多多商家工作台">🚀拼多多商家工作台</h1>
<p><img alt="image-20260826230116881" loading="lazy" data-src="https://worklink.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/F4A588F85A09A809C78348D2ECE6D3DF.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 id="目前已经实现的功能">目前已经实现的功能</h3>
<ol>
<li>发文字，发图片，发视频</li>
<li>收消息，右下角提示弹窗</li>
<li>标记已读，转接到客服</li>
<li>获取cookie</li>
</ol>
<pre><code class="language-js">
//起一个websocket client
let heartbeatInterval;
let socket = new WebSocket("ws://127.0.0.1:41010");

socket.onopen = async (e) =&gt; {
    console.log('[WebSocket] Connected');
    startHeartbeat();
};

socket.onmessage = async function(event) {
    let recvData = JSON.parse(event.data);
    console.log(recvData);
};

socket.onclose = function(event) {
    clearInterval(heartbeatInterval);
};

function startHeartbeat() {
    heartbeatInterval = setInterval(() =&gt; {
        if (socket.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
            socket.send(JSON.stringify({ method: 'heartbeat',token:'token' }));
        } else {
            clearInterval(heartbeatInterval); 
        }
    }, 3000);
}

socket.onerror = function(error) {
    console.error('[WebSocket] Error:', error);
};

1. 接受到的消息都在  socket.onmessage里
2. 所有接口的返回值也都在 socket.onmessage里



//获取所有登录的店铺
socket.send(JSON.stringify({id:crypto.randomUUID(),method:'getmalls'}))

//获取当前选中的店铺
socket.send(JSON.stringify({id:crypto.randomUUID(),method:'getcurrentmall'}))

//发文字
socket.send(JSON.stringify({id:crypto.randomUUID(),method:'sendtext',mallid:'账号的csid',uid:"客户Id",text:'你好'}))

//发图片
socket.send(JSON.stringify({id:crypto.randomUUID(),method:'sendimage',mallid:'账号的csid',uid:"客户Id",image:'data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAA'}))

//获取店铺视频素材
socket.send(JSON.stringify({id:crypto.randomUUID(),method:'getvideos',mallid:'账号的csid'}))

//发视频
socket.send(JSON.stringify({id:crypto.randomUUID(),method:'sendvideo',mallid:'账号的csid',uid:"客户Id",videoUrl:'https://xxx'}))

//获取店铺在线子账号
socket.send(JSON.stringify({id:crypto.randomUUID(),method:'getassigncslist',mallid:'账号的csid'}))

//转到到其他客服
socket.send(JSON.stringify({id:crypto.randomUUID(),method:'moveconv',mallid:'账号的csid',tomallid:"目标客服csid",uid:"客户Id",reason:'转接原因'}))

//获取店铺聊天客户的列表
socket.send(JSON.stringify({id:crypto.randomUUID(),method:'getchatlist',mallid:'账号的csid'}))

//passid 约等于 cookie
socket.send(JSON.stringify({id:crypto.randomUUID(),method:'getpassid',mallid:'账号的csid'}))

//获取anticontent
socket.send(JSON.stringify({id:crypto.randomUUID(),method:'getanticontent',mallid:'账号的csid'}))

//标记已读
socket.send(JSON.stringify({id:crypto.randomUUID(),method:'markread',mallid:'账号的csid',uid:"客户Id"}))

//获取店铺商品
socket.send(JSON.stringify({id:crypto.randomUUID(),method:'getgoods',mallid:'账号的csid',page:1,pageSize:10}))

//获取买家足迹
socket.send(JSON.stringify({id:crypto.randomUUID(),method:'getfootprint',mallid:'账号的csid',uid:"客户Id",page:1,pageSize:10}))

//获取买家历史消息, cursor 传最近的消息id，从传入的消息id开始获取历史消息
socket.send(JSON.stringify({id:crypto.randomUUID(),method:'gethistorymessages',mallid:'账号的csid',uid:"客户Id",cursor:'214987741649',pageSize:10}))

//修改订单备注
socket.send(JSON.stringify({id:crypto.randomUUID(),method:'updateorderremark',mallid:'账号的csid',orderSn:"订单号",remark:'',remarkTag:'',RemarkTagName:''}))

</code></pre>
